approvalSource: User confirmed the preview before authorizing implementation.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE high-fidelity Chinese WeChat mini-program mobile screen, preview-only design comp, not production screenshot.
Primary request: Design the simplified daily Todo page for the existing "拾课课表" mini-program. Render ONE flat, front-facing, edge-to-edge portrait phone-screen artboard, approximately 9:19.5 aspect ratio. No device frame, no perspective, no desk, no surrounding presentation board, no multiple screens. The entire main page should be clearly readable from date navigation through the bottom two-tab bar. This is a practical shippable native mini-program interface, not concept art or a marketing poster.

Visual authority: existing app has a cool light gray-blue page background #F2F5F7, white surfaces, restrained teal-green #267D78 accents, pale teal #DCECEA, dark green-gray primary text #263D38, accessible secondary text #58706A, PingFang SC/system Chinese sans-serif. Preserve these, use clean native rounded corners, almost imperceptible shadows or simple dividers, uncluttered spacing, strong readable Chinese typography. Do NOT adopt the cream/gold palette, tomato branding, habits, or five-tab bar from the original reference. No invented logos.

Composition in order:
1. White native status bar and WeChat navigation bar occupying the upper safe area, time "9:41", centered title "待办", native small WeChat capsule with three dots and a hollow circle on the right.
2. Spacious but compact date navigation, centered bold teal "2026年9月16日" with a small downward chevron indicating tappable date picker, native left/right thin teal chevrons on either side with ample tap areas. Under the date show smaller text "星期三 · 今天". Do not show a week strip or calendar grid.
3. Section heading "今日目标" on the left, smaller count "已完成 1/3" on the right. A single clean white goal-list surface contains exactly THREE saved task rows:
   - Unchecked round checkbox, dark title "整理数学错题", right-side subtle three-dot menu.
   - Unchecked round checkbox, dark title "准备明天的课程资料", right-side subtle three-dot menu.
   - Checked teal circle with white tick, muted struck-through title "完成英语阅读", right-side subtle three-dot menu.
   These are exactly two pending and one completed, consistent with 1/3. Unfinished rows precede the completed row. Thin subtle separators, no dates, no time labels, no deadline badges, no global pending/completed filter tabs.
4. Below the saved rows, show the INLINE ADD-GOAL composer in its expanded demonstration state, visually distinct from the saved rows but NOT a fourth checkbox task. Heading with a small plus and exact text "添加目标". A simple title input with placeholder "写下一件要做的事". A smaller disclosure label "备注（可选）" with upward chevron, and a compact expanded note field with placeholder "补充说明，可留空". Bottom action row with secondary text button "取消" and a modest solid teal primary button "保存". Do not add any date field, execution-time field, deadline field or time pickers. Make this composer compact enough that the daily thoughts area also fits comfortably, without squeezing text or shrinking all typography. No floating add button or duplicate add action while this composer is open.
5. Section heading "随想记录" on the left, a small teal check and exact status "已保存" on the right. Below, a clean white multiline text area, comfortable padding and a few lines of example content, exactly:
"今天先把最重要的一件事做好。
复习时把不懂的地方记下来，明天再看一遍。"
Small muted helper text below the text area: "输入后自动保存".
6. Above the bottom navigation, one unobtrusive legible line of muted helper copy: "未完成目标次日过期，历史记录仍保留". This explains expiration without falsely marking today's tasks expired.
7. Existing native white bottom tab bar, ONLY TWO evenly spaced TEXT-only tabs: "课表" in gray-green on the left and "待办" in teal on the right. Do not add icon illustrations, month/year/settings tabs, or any habit module. Include the bottom safe area/home indicator.

Text: All Chinese must be rendered verbatim, with accurate characters and crisp readable type. No extra English labels or extra explanatory titles outside the app screen. Example tasks and thoughts are synthetic preview content, not real user data.
Constraints: minimalist operational UI, realistic Chinese native mini-program affordances, generous but economical spacing, visually coherent with existing teal-green app. No habit tracking, streaks, points, graphs, achievement badges, completion rings, gamification, reminders, execution start/end time, deadline fields, global filters, promotional slogans, large empty illustrations, watermarks, textures, gradients or decorative imagery. One consistent task checkbox style, one primary action. The inline composer and thought editor must feel like two different purposes: goal title plus optional task note versus one daily journal.
